title: Speaking and Writing Priority
summary: A 42-day recovery plan for learners whose Writing and/or Speaking bands sit at least half a band below their Reading and Listening (overall 3.5–5). Most hours go to Build a Sentence, the email, the discussion post, Listen and Repeat and the interview, with Reading and Listening kept in short maintenance sessions.

schedule_json.split: About 70% Speaking and Writing, 30% Reading and Listening maintenance
daily_routine: 10 minutes: ten Listen and Repeat sentences, recorded and checked word by word
25–35 minutes: one timed writing task or one interview set
10 minutes: Build a Sentence items or a proofread of yesterday's writing
15 minutes (alternate days): Reading or Listening maintenance set

weeks.label: Week 1 · Baseline and productive audit
tasks: Full mock 1 in the TOEFL simulator; record all four section bands.
Audit Writing: Build a Sentence score, email bullets covered, discussion contribution, and every grammar error found.
Audit Speaking: Listen and Repeat sentences with any change, interview answers under about 35 seconds of content.
Write your personal top-five grammar errors on a card.
Remember the weight: Listen and Repeat is 35 of 55 raw Speaking points; Build a Sentence is 10 of 20 raw Writing points.
Weekly review: choose the first focus (Speaking or Writing) from the audit.

checkpoint.target: Gap between productive and receptive sections confirmed (0.5 band or more)

weeks.label: Week 2 · Accuracy engines: Build a Sentence and Listen and Repeat
tasks: Three Build a Sentence sets; log each miss by structure (question order, relative clause, embedded question, passive).
Daily Listen and Repeat: ten sentences, one repetition each, function words and endings counted.
Thought-group routine: mark slashes and stress on five long sentences, repeat, record.
Two short Reading or Listening maintenance sets.
Weekly review: Build a Sentence accuracy and exact-repetition count.

simulator.action: Build a Sentence and Listen and Repeat sets

checkpoint.measure: Build a Sentence score and exact repetitions out of 10
checkpoint.target: Both higher than the week 1 audit

weeks.label: Week 3 · The email and the interview
tasks: Three emails: one formal, one polite-efficient, one friendly, each in 7 minutes with the two-minute proofread.
Compare each email with the annotated models in the Email and Discussion Templates guide.
Two interviews focusing on the Recall and Reaction frameworks; record and self-score.
Shrinking-timer routine on two questions.
Section mock: Speaking in simulator practice; review.
Weekly review.

checkpoint.measure: Speaking section mock band; emails with every bullet covered
checkpoint.target: Speaking at or above baseline; all bullets covered in 3 of 3 emails

weeks.label: Week 4 · The discussion and opinion answers
tasks: Three discussion posts in 10 minutes each; check that each one adds something new to the classmates' posts.
Rewrite one sentence per post with a limiting clause or precise contrast.
Two interviews focusing on the Position and Proposal frameworks.
Stress and intonation routine: contrast stress and new-information stress.
Section mock: Writing in simulator practice; review.
Weekly review.

checkpoint.target: Writing at least half a band above baseline, or errors-found-later count halved

weeks.label: Week 5 · Full mock 2 and fine-tuning
tasks: Full mock 2 in the TOEFL simulator.
Recount productive error categories (W-grammar, W-word, W-task, S-exact, S-flow, S-develop).
Two sessions on the largest remaining category.
Check Reading and Listening have not dropped; add a maintenance session if they have.
Start the Final 14 Days guide if your test is two weeks away.
Weekly review.

checkpoint.measure: Mock 2 bands for all four sections
checkpoint.target: Gap between productive and receptive sections smaller than at baseline

weeks.label: Week 6 · Consolidate and perform
tasks: Two timed pairs: email plus discussion, and seven Listen and Repeat sentences plus one interview.
Write the top-ten error list, weighted toward Writing and Speaking.
Logistics: ID, recipients, equipment check (Home Edition) or route (test center).
Light practice only in the last three days.
Test day, or continue with the Eight-Week Standard plan if mock 2 showed the gap is still large.

checkpoint.target: Every email bullet covered, every post adds a new point, Listen and Repeat mostly exact

decision_rules: If Listen and Repeat exact repetitions do not rise by week 3, slow down: repeat shorter sentences perfectly before longer ones.
If the same grammar errors keep appearing, proofread only for your personal top five until they disappear.
If Reading or Listening drops by half a band, add two maintenance sessions a week.

metadata.primary_focus_note: focus_section holds one value; this plan covers speaking and writing (see focus_sections)
metadata.entry_rule: Writing and/or Speaking at least 0.5 band below Reading and Listening
metadata.recommended_for: Profile A learners: receptive skills strong, productive skills weaker.
metadata.score_window_basis: score_min/score_max are the ETS 0-120 comparison totals for band 3.5 (58+) and the top of band 5.5 (113); band windows are in band_*
metadata.guarantee: none: practice plan, not a score prediction
